original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-right-derived}
Let $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$ be a ringed site.
Let $(\mathcal{A}, \text{d})$ be a sheaf of differential graded algebras on
$(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$. Then any exact functor
$$
T : K(\textit{Mod}(\mathcal{A}, \text{d})) \longrightarrow \mathcal{D}
$$
of triangulated categories has a right derived extension
$RT : D(\mathcal{A}, \text{d}) \to \mathcal{D}$
whose value on a graded injective and K-injective
differential graded $\mathcal{A}$-module $\mathcal{I}$
is $T(\mathcal{I})$.
stage_b_review_note: Pinned proof-safe sdga lemma 4879 asserts an exact triangulated functor from the homotopy category of DG A-modules admits a right-derived extension to the derived category, computed as T(I) on DG modules I that are both graded injective and K-injective. The prepared hypotheses keep the ringed site and DG algebra, and the conclusion preserves exactness, the target category and both injectivity requirements.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-derived-adjoint-tensor-hom}
Let $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$ be a ringed site. Let
$\mathcal{A}$, $\mathcal{B}$ be differential graded $\mathcal{O}$-algebras.
Let $\mathcal{N}$ be a  differential graded
$(\mathcal{A}, \mathcal{B})$-bimodule. Then
$$
R\SheafHom_\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{N}, -) :
D(\mathcal{B}, \text{d})
\longrightarrow
D(\mathcal{A}, \text{d})
$$
is right adjoint to
$$
- \otimes_\mathcal{A}^\mathbf{L} \mathcal{N} :
D(\mathcal{A}, \text{d})
\longrightarrow
D(\mathcal{B}, \text{d})
$$
stage_b_review_note: Pinned proof-safe lemma 4961 asserts the right-derived sheaf-Hom functor RHom_B(N,-):D(B)→D(A) is right adjoint to the derived extension-of-scalars functor -⊗^L_A N:D(A)→D(B) for an (A,B)-DG bimodule N. The prepared adjunction and functor directions are identical, not reversed.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-derived-adjoint-push-pull}
Let $(f, f^\sharp) : (\Sh(\mathcal{C}), \mathcal{O}_\mathcal{C})
\to (\Sh(\mathcal{D}), \mathcal{O}_\mathcal{D})$
be a morphism of ringed topoi. Let $\mathcal{A}$ be a differential
graded $\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{C}$-algebra. Let $\mathcal{B}$ be a
differential graded $\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{D}$-algebra. Let
$\varphi : \mathcal{B} \to f_*\mathcal{A}$ be a homomorphism
of differential graded $\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{D}$-algebras.
Then
$$
Rf_* : 
D(\mathcal{A}, \text{d})
\longrightarrow
D(\mathcal{B}, \text{d})
$$
is right adjoint to
$$
Lf^* :
D(\mathcal{B}, \text{d})
\longrightarrow
D(\mathcal{A}, \text{d})
$$
stage_b_review_note: Pinned proof-safe lemma 4988 assumes a morphism of ringed topoi and compatible DG-algebra homomorphism B→f_*A; the right derived direct-image Rf_*:D(A)→D(B) is the right adjoint of Lf*:D(B)→D(A). Stage A retains both DG-algebra structures, the compatibility map and exact source/target orientation.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-compose-pushforward}
Let $(f, f^\sharp) : (\Sh(\mathcal{C}), \mathcal{O})
\to (\Sh(\mathcal{C}'), \mathcal{O}')$ and
$(g, g^\sharp) : (\Sh(\mathcal{C}'), \mathcal{O}')
\to (\Sh(\mathcal{C}''), \mathcal{O}'')$
be morphisms of ringed topoi. Let $\mathcal{A}$, $\mathcal{A}'$, and
$\mathcal{A}''$ be a differential graded $\mathcal{O}$-algebra,
$\mathcal{O}'$-algebra, and $\mathcal{O}''$-algebra. Let
$\varphi : \mathcal{A}' \to f_*\mathcal{A}$ and
$\varphi' : \mathcal{A}'' \to g_*\mathcal{A}'$
be a homomorphism of differential graded $\mathcal{O}'$-algebras
and $\mathcal{O}''$-algebras.
Then we have $R(g \circ f)_* = Rg_* \circ Rf_* :
D(\mathcal{A}, \text{d}) \to D(\mathcal{A}'', \text{d})$.
stage_b_review_note: Pinned proof-safe lemma 5106 assumes composable morphisms of ringed topoi and compatible DG-algebra maps A'→f_*A, A''→g_*A'. It identifies the right derived pushforward of g∘f with Rg_*∘Rf_* from D(A) to D(A''). The statement, compatibility chain and composition order are unchanged.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-compose-hom}
Let $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$ be a ringed site. Let
$\mathcal{A}$, $\mathcal{A}'$, $\mathcal{A}''$ be differential graded
$\mathcal{O}$-algebras. Let $\mathcal{N}$ and $\mathcal{N}'$ be a
differential graded $(\mathcal{A}, \mathcal{A}')$-bimodule
and $(\mathcal{A}', \mathcal{A}'')$-bimodule. Assume
that the canonical map
$$
\mathcal{N} \otimes_{\mathcal{A}'}^\mathbf{L} \mathcal{N}'
\longrightarrow
\mathcal{N} \otimes_{\mathcal{A}'} \mathcal{N}'
$$
in $D(\mathcal{A}'', \text{d})$ is a quasi-isomorphism.
Then we have
$$
R\SheafHom_{\mathcal{A}''}
(\mathcal{N} \otimes_{\mathcal{A}'} \mathcal{N}', -)
=
R\SheafHom_{\mathcal{A}'}(\mathcal{N},
R\SheafHom_{\mathcal{A}''}(\mathcal{N}', -))
$$
as functors $D(\mathcal{A}'', \text{d}) \to D(\mathcal{A}, \text{d})$.
stage_b_review_note: Pinned proof-safe lemma 5129 assumes DG bimodules N, N' and the specific comparison N⊗^L_{A'}N'→N⊗_{A'}N' is a quasi-isomorphism, then identifies RHom_{A''}(N⊗_{A'}N',-) with the composite RHom_{A'}(N,RHom_{A''}(N',-)) on D(A'')→D(A). Stage A retains this essential derived-to-underived comparison, the order of N/N' and the functor categories.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-pushforward-agrees}
Let $(f, f^\sharp) : (\Sh(\mathcal{C}), \mathcal{O}_\mathcal{C})
\to (\Sh(\mathcal{D}), \mathcal{O}_\mathcal{D})$
be a morphism of ringed topoi. Let $\mathcal{A}$ be a differential
graded $\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{C}$-algebra. Let $\mathcal{B}$ be a
differential graded $\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{D}$-algebra. Let
$\varphi : \mathcal{B} \to f_*\mathcal{A}$ be a homomorphism
of differential graded $\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{D}$-algebras.
The diagram
$$
\xymatrix{
D(\mathcal{A}, \text{d}) \ar[d]_{Rf_*} \ar[rr]_{forget} & &
D(\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{C}) \ar[d]^{Rf_*} \\
D(\mathcal{B}, \text{d}) \ar[rr]^{forget} & &
D(\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{D})
}
$$
commutes.
stage_b_review_note: Pinned proof-safe lemma 5160 gives commutativity of the square comparing derived direct image of DG-algebra modules with underlying derived direct image of O-modules. The prepared diagram preserves the two forgetful arrows, Rf_* arrows and the B→f_*A compatibility map.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-cohomology-ext}
Let $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$ be a ringed site.
Let $\mathcal{A}$ be a differential graded $\mathcal{O}$-algebra.
Let $\mathcal{M}$ be a differential graded $\mathcal{A}$-module.
Let $n \in \mathbf{Z}$. We have
$$
H^n(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{M}) =
\Hom_{D(\mathcal{A}, \text{d})}(\mathcal{A}, \mathcal{M}[n])
$$
where on the left hand side we have the cohomology of $\mathcal{M}$
viewed as a complex of $\mathcal{O}$-modules.
stage_b_review_note: Pinned proof-safe lemma 5233 gives H^n(C,M)=Hom_{D(A,d)}(A,M[n]), where the left side is the hypercohomology of the underlying O-complex of DG A-module M. Stage A retains the integer shift n, orientation of Hom and the underlying-complex convention.
